name: Terminalia chebula extract
description: Terminalia chebula extract (CAS 90131-48-9 ), derived from the dried fruit of the haritaki tree, is a concentrated botanical ingredient used across food, pharmaceutical, and personal care manufacturing. Standardized for polyphenol and tannin content, it functions as a natural antioxidant and stabilizing agent in finished formulations. In nutraceutical and dietary supplement production, it is incorporated into capsules and tablets. Functional food products targeting antioxidant support frequently utilize this extract. Personal care formulators use it in anti-aging creams, serums, and scalp treatments where oxidative stress protection is a primary objective. Pharmaceutical manufacturers source it as a botanical active for inclusion in herbal preparations and standardized plant-based products. Food producers apply it as a natural antioxidant to extend shelf stability. Terminalia chebula extract is supplied as a fine powder, typically spray-dried or vacuum-dried, suitable for direct blending or encapsulation. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications. Material is commonly standardized to defined polyphenol or tannin percentages. Organic-certified material is available from select suppliers to meet clean-label and natural product requirements for global distribution. The ingredient meets rigorous quality benchmarks including FCC and USP standards where applicable.
